updates.title: Oasis3 — in production
updates.body: Development on Oasis3 is underway: a modern RuneScape base targeting rev 949. Core systems are being stood up now.
updates.author: Xavier

updates.title: Targeting rev 949
updates.body: Oasis3 is being built on the rev 949 protocol — the groundwork for a full RS3-style Oasis experience on our own server.
updates.author: Andrew

updates.title: What's coming
updates.body: Custom Oasis content follows once the protocol is solid. Follow along in Discord for milestone drops.
updates.author: Xavier
